ports.name: heatCapacitor.port.Q_flow
ports.description: Heat flow rate (positive if flowing from outside into the component)

ports.name: heatingResistor.v
ports.description: Voltage drop between the two pins (= p.v - n.v)

ports.name: heatingResistor.i
ports.description: Current flowing from pin p to pin n

ports.name: heatingResistor.LossPower
ports.description: Loss power leaving component via heatPort

ports.name: temperatureSensor.T
ports.description: Absolute temperature in degree Celsius as output signal

ports.name: thermalConductor.Q_flow
ports.description: Heat flow rate from port_a -> port_b

ports.name: idealSwitch.v
ports.description: Voltage drop between the two pins (= p.v - n.v)

ports.name: idealSwitch.LossPower
ports.description: Loss power leaving component via heatPort

ports.name: onOffController.y
ports.description: Connector of Real output signal used as actuator signal

ports.name: heatingResistor.alpha
ports.description: Temperature coefficient of resistance (R = R_ref*(1 + alpha*(heatPort.T - T_ref))

ports.name: heatingResistor.T
ports.description: Fixed device temperature if useHeatPort = false
